matchup_findings.statement: Fresno State holds the early-down edge: its offense stays ahead of the chains on 1st and 2nd down against this defense (+1.29) more than San Diego State does (-0.96).

Fresno State owns the stronger opponent-adjusted finishing matchup: San Diego State offense vs Fresno State defense -1.64, Fresno State offense vs San Diego State defense +0.58 (points per scoring opportunity, opponent-adjusted: Fresno State offense #65 of 138, San Diego State defense #75 of 138).

Fresno State owns the stronger opponent-adjusted scoring matchup: San Diego State offense vs Fresno State defense -1.44, Fresno State offense vs San Diego State defense +1.18 (points per game, opponent-adjusted: Fresno State offense #64 of 138, San Diego State defense #121 of 138).

Fresno State owns the stronger opponent-adjusted sustained-efficiency matchup: San Diego State offense vs Fresno State defense -1.38, Fresno State offense vs San Diego State defense +0.66 (success rate, opponent-adjusted: Fresno State offense #73 of 138, San Diego State defense #121 of 138).
Fresno State's defense out-rates the opposing offense on a down-to-down basis (-1.38 for San Diego State's offense).

Fresno State's passing offense meets a San Diego State defense it out-rates on the matchup scale (+1.47) (pass success rate, opponent-adjusted: Fresno State offense #30 of 138, San Diego State defense #125 of 138).
Fresno State's defense has forced turnovers at a high rate (+1.17 SD) while allowing average-or-worse yards per play: takeaways are regression-prone.
Fresno State's offense has swung widely from game to game relative to its opponents (game-to-game residual variation in the 99th percentile of FBS).
2 independent volatility indicators are present: this matchup has wide outcomes.

pace.definition: possession_environment = (z of home offense plays + z of away defense plays allowed + z of away offense plays + z of home defense plays allowed) / 2, on adjusted values. Positive = more snaps than an average FBS game. tempo_environment = -(z of each offense's possession seconds per play) / 2

volatility.definition: offense_ypp_residual_sd = game-to-game spread of the offense's yards per play around what the fit expected against each opponent; its percentile is within the FBS universe. explosive_yard_share_z is the raw share standardised across FBS (not opponent-adjusted). takeaways_per_game_z and giveaways_per_game_z are RAW per-game turnover counts standardised across FBS: turnovers are regression-prone and are deliberately not opponent-adjusted.

adjusted_unavailable_reason: descriptive tendency: opponent adjustment does not apply to this metric (V1)

scoring_baseline.label: opponent-adjusted scoring baseline -- descriptive, uncalibrated, NOT a projection
